refine.intro: Adjust this proposal: drop a food you don't have, or pin a quantity. The AI re-proposes honouring these constraints and all the day's targets.

ha.helpTitle: Where to find the token and entity id?
ha.help1: In HA: profile (bottom-left) → Security → Long-lived access tokens → create a token and paste it here.

help.title: How to connect Gemini (step by step)
help.intro: No technical knowledge needed — just follow these steps:
help.step1: Sign in to Google AI Studio with a Google account (free).
help.step2: Click “Create API key”, then copy the key into the “API key” field above.
help.step3: Click “Use the Gemini URL” under the Base URL field — or paste it yourself: {{url}}
help.step4: Click “Fetch models”, then pick a model for each task — a vision-capable model (e.g. gemini-2.x) for photo analysis.
help.modelNote: A “model” is the AI variant that answers a task.

claude.title: How to connect Claude (step by step)
claude.step1: Sign in to the Anthropic console and open API keys.
claude.step2: Create a key, then copy it into the “API key” field above.
claude.step3: Click “Use the Claude URL” under the Base URL field — or paste it yourself: {{url}}
claude.step4: Click “Fetch models”, then pick a Claude model (e.g. a recent claude-sonnet) for each task.
claude.note: Claude (Anthropic) is billed per token — there is no free tier.

gdrive.desc: Automatic daily backup of your data export to your own Google Drive. Optional and off by default.

help.title: How to set up Google Drive (step by step)
help.intro: Each operator uses their own Google OAuth client (Macronome ships none). Follow these steps:
help.step1: Create (or pick) a project in the Google Cloud Console:
help.step2: Enable the Google Drive API for that project:
help.step3: Configure the OAuth consent screen as “External”:
help.step4: Add the “…/auth/drive.file” scope — the app only accesses the files it creates (its “Macronome Backups” folder).
help.step5: Publish the consent screen to “Production”: in “Testing” Google expires the token after 7 days. The app stays “unverified” — the warning is expected and safe to accept.
help.step6: Create an OAuth client ID of type “Web application”:
help.step7: Register exactly this authorized redirect URI:
help.step8: Copy the client ID and client secret into the fields above, then click “Connect”.
help.publishNote: Tip: publishing to Production avoids having to reconnect every 7 days.

errors.gdrive_not_configured: Enter the client ID and client secret first, then save.
errors.gdrive_insecure_context: The server needs an HTTPS origin. Behind a reverse proxy / tunnel (e.g. Cloudflare), set the PUBLIC_ORIGIN variable (e.g. https://your-domain) — or set TRUSTED_PROXY (e.g. uniquelocal) so the app trusts the proxy. The callback URL shown below is computed by the browser: seeing it in https isn't enough.
